messages:
Jules (AE): Heads-up  Prospect Voltix is blocking the POC until we hand over SOC2 extracts, an ISO network diagram with peering notes, and a signed pen-test attestation. They also want a note about billing impact if we switch to Dedicated mid-POC. Can we do 72h?
Aiden (SE): I can assemble the ISO diagram and the short tech checklist. Quick q: do they need the full SOC2 PDF or will a redacted executive summary + control mappings do for procurement?
Renee (Security): We provide exec summary and control narratives immediately. Full SOC2 Type II PDF only under NDA. Pen-test attestation: we have a template that Legal signs. We do not provide raw server logs or forensic timelines.
Tom (Legal): I can sign the attestation once Security posts the final phrasing. For the billing note: Legal needs the exact wording of the customers' ask to avoid implying SLA changes. Please paste draft attestation and any billing language.
pricing-bot: Quick estimate: Hosted POC = baseline. Switching to Dedicated mid-POC may incur a provisioning uplift ~+30% pro-rated for remaining term and a 3-5 day lead time for networking. Detailed quote on request.
Aiden (SE): Voltix also asked whether we can demonstrate CMK in the POC. CMK/HSM demos only on Dedicated. Hosted provides our managed keys with standard encryption controls.
Jules (AE): Contact at Voltix is secops@voltix.io. I'll ask for CIDR and whether they'll execute NDA. They want to see "no raw logs shared" explicitly in writing.
Renee (Security): Suggested pen-test attestation wording:
``
Pen-test Attestation - Redwood Inference
- Recipient: <Voltix>
- Scope: staging test tenant; API endpoints; auth flows
- Assessment: Independent third-party assessment completed <MM/YYYY>. High/critical findings remediated or accepted with documented mitigations. Full report available upon NDA; redacted summary may be provided without NDA.
- Log Disclosure: Redwood does not disclose raw server logs or intrusion timelines to customers.
- Signatory: Authorized Legal signatory
``
Tom (Legal): That reads fine. Replace <MM/YYYY> with assessment month and I'll sign. For billing note: propose "If customer requests Dedicated mid-POC, customer will be billed pro-rata for Reserved capacity and any one-time networking setup fees." Approve?
Aiden (SE): Approved. Add a second line: "Provisioning lead time: 3-5 business days after order."
Jules (AE): Action items: 1) Renee: finalize attestation & SOC2 exec summary upload. 2) Aiden: prep ISO diagram and note Dedicated lead times. 3) Tom: sign attestation once date filled. 4) Jules: request CIDR and NDA from secops@voltix.io and surface Dedicated cost if they push.
Tom (Legal): I'll sign once the date is added. Jules, loop me in the email.
Jules (AE): Thanks all  I'll push for Hosted to meet the 72h window and flag Dedicated trade-offs.
